build_masked_language_model: build a MaskedLanguageModel from config with encoder, decoder, and output layer for BERT pre-training
create_mlm_from_config: create a MaskedLanguageModel instance from a Config object and tensorizers dictionary using from_config
review_masking_strategy: review the MaskedLanguageModel masking strategy to choose between random and frequency based token masking
test_forward_pass: test the MaskedLanguageModel forward pass that encodes inputs and decodes masked token predictions
refactor_mask_input: refactor the MaskedLanguageModel _mask_input method to apply mask tokens and random replacements to input sequences
